recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Any future refinement should be handled as a separate ballot/comment decision about wording, examples, or terminology for InsuranceProduct.related.relationship rather than as an unapplied FHIR-33272 gap.
issue_request: FHIR-33272 was an Applied/Persuasive Patient Administration change request asking for InsurancePlan to support multiple member or sub-plans. Its final resolution depended on the FHIR-24827 InsurancePlan/InsuranceProduct restructuring and specified InsuranceProduct.related 0..* with product 0..1 Reference(InsuranceProduct), relationship 0..1 CodeableConcept, and period 0..1 Period.
initial_application: Commit 3df002d6fcf42ae5314a842de212217529f0a5c0 added InsuranceProduct.related and its product, relationship, and period children to source/insuranceproduct/structuredefinition-InsuranceProduct.xml. Commit 3a93debb820c6ec5c6b9973c72fd174aaaa2e693 then added InsurancePlan.product and the matching InsurancePlan product search parameter as part of the same restructuring trail. Later PA QA commit 8d3a218d6c06a42e981b2caf729ab16963b9073c only adjusted wording such as the related element short label.
additional_context: FHIR-24827 is the supporting Applied/Persuasive restructuring decision that split InsurancePlan and InsuranceProduct, so the seed's member/sub-plan relationship is correctly represented on InsuranceProduct rather than the current InsurancePlan resource. source/fhir.ini actively lists both InsurancePlan and InsuranceProduct and marks both resources normative. Confluence May 2023 PA/FM minutes and the December 2023 PA Zulip thread describe adding the related Product property for FHIR-33272. Later FHIR-47650 clarified InsuranceProduct narrative/definition content without changing or contradicting InsuranceProduct.related.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/insuranceproduct/structuredefinition-InsuranceProduct.xml already defines InsuranceProduct.related 0..* with product Reference(InsuranceProduct), relationship CodeableConcept, and period Period in active build scope.
